This application stands disposed of.
BAIL APPLN. 4956/2025 & CRL.M.A. 38229/2025 (for directions to call the TCR)

1. This is an application for grant of regular bail filed on behalf of applicant in case FIR No.
553/2019, under Sections 376 IPC and Section 6 POCSO Act, registered at Police Station Prem Nagar.
2. Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by learned APP appearing for the State, who seeks time to file the status report.
3. Status report be filed on or before the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 23/12/2025 at 21:02:10 4.
Notice be also sent to the prosecutrix through the Investigating Officer with direction to inform her of her legal right to have an advocate at State's expense.
5. Re-notify on 10.02.2026.
6. In the meanwhile, nominal roll of the applicant be requisitioned from the Jail Superintendent.
